{"code": "obs = get_observation()
report = {
    'initial_held_by': obs.get('held_by'),
    'initial_bottle_center_m': obs.get('bottle_center_m'),
    'initial_upright': obs.get('upright'),
}
if obs.get('upright') is not True:
    raise ValueError('precondition: bottle not upright at start')

p = pick(arm='right', hold_seconds=2, next_handover={'to_arm': 'left'})
report['pick_ok'] = p.ok
report['pick_steps'] = p.steps_executed
if not p.ok:
    raise ValueError('pick failed: ' + str(p.diagnostics.get('failure_code')) + ' holder=' + str(p.diagnostics.get('current_holder')))
obs = get_observation()
report['after_pick_held_by'] = obs.get('held_by')
if 'right' not in (obs.get('held_by') or []):
    raise ValueError('grasp failure: right does not hold after pick')

h = handover(from_arm='right', to_arm='left', hold_seconds=2)
report['handover_ok'] = h.ok
report['handover_steps'] = h.steps_executed
if not h.ok:
    raise ValueError('handover failed: ' + str(h.diagnostics.get('failure_code')) + ' holder=' + str(h.diagnostics.get('current_holder')))
obs = get_observation()
report['after_handover_held_by'] = obs.get('held_by')
if 'left' not in (obs.get('held_by') or []):
    raise ValueError('handover receiver mismatch: left does not hold after handover')

pl = place(arm='left', receptacle_id='basket')
report['place_ok'] = pl.ok
report['place_steps'] = pl.steps_executed
if not pl.ok:
    raise ValueError('place failed: ' + str(pl.diagnostics.get('failure_code')) + ' holder=' + str(pl.diagnostics.get('current_holder')))

obs = get_observation()
report['final_held_by'] = obs.get('held_by')
report['final_bottle_center_m'] = obs.get('bottle_center_m')
report['final_upright'] = obs.get('upright')
result = report", "hypothesis": "Gating the pick->handover->place sequence on re-observed held_by (right after pick, left after handover) and on .ok at each primitive will make the relay fail loudly at the first unsupported stage instead of proceeding, and the 5 development seeds (51-55) should still reach protocol success with the same 3 motion calls. Untested on other seeds or bottle poses; no paired comparison against v1 has been run.", "changes": ["Rebuilt program from the skill's protocol: observe upright precondition, then pick(right, next_handover={'to_arm':'left'}), handover(right->left), place(left, basket).","Added held_by re-observation after pick and after handover; raise ValueError on receiver/holder mismatch instead of proceeding.","Each failed primitive raises ValueError including diagnostics failure_code and current_holder.","Final report records held_by and bottle_center_m after place; returning normally is not treated as success.","No move_relative, no retries, no stored coordinates; all branching is on observations and .ok flags."]}
